posts.title: What kind of music do you listen to?
posts.description: I've always hated being asked that question. When I was younger, especially in middle school, it was out of fear. What if my taste was too weird? What if it was the wrong way to enjoy that particular genre? What if it revealed something about me that I didn't want to share?
